catalog_model_artifact: Set catalog.model_xml_path to the exact runtime compiled .mjb for disable_fingers=True MyoFullBody; source .xml/.mjcf is supported only when it compiles to the identical runtime model.

required_arrays.teacher_ctrl_physical_or_applied_ctrl: float[T,M], actual transition data.ctrl in model units
required_arrays.actuator_names: unicode[M], exact ordered physical control channels

optional_checked_arrays.muscle_excitation: float[T,M], checked against the recomputed ctrlrange transform
optional_checked_arrays.success: scalar or numeric[T], all values must equal one
optional_checked_arrays.actuator_ctrlrange: float[M,2], checked against the live compiled model
optional_checked_arrays.model_hash: scalar unicode, checked against the live compiled model
optional_checked_arrays.ctrlrange_schema_hash: scalar unicode, checked against the live compiled model

transition_timing: teacher_ctrl_physical is the control applied from s_t to s_t+1; phase_id labels that same event transition
